title: Authenticated remote MCP, tenancy and data residency
claim_boundary: A feature-gated read-only loopback Streamable HTTP adapter is compiler- and fixture-tested. This is not evidence of a hosted, multi-replica, production-secure or independently approved service.

open_gates: Exercise a real IdP and trusted TLS edge in an approved isolated deployment.
Rehearse deployment rollback and preserve exact configuration-bound evidence.
assertions.permitted_claim: A disabled-by-default, loopback-only authenticated read-only Streamable HTTP adapter is fixture-tested. Hosted availability or security is not claimed.

assertions.statement: Default-deny scopes and human-only final decisions
open_gates: Keep the remote tool surface read-only until a method-specific scope and cryptographically bound approval design is reviewed.
assertions.permitted_claim: The current remote tool surface is exhaustively classified read-only and requires review_read; state-changing remote authority is not available.

assertions.statement: Tenant isolation, residency, rate and cancellation budgets
open_gates: Prove shared atomic replay, rate and task budgets across multiple replicas.
Prove deployment, storage, replication and logging residency rather than token-claim region alone.
Complete independent security/privacy review and approved rollback rehearsal.
assertions.permitted_claim: In-process tenant, region, replay, rate, concurrency, timeout and redacted-audit controls are fixture-tested; multi-tenant deployment isolation is not claimed.
